data.problem: Clarify and improve visibility into tool call lifecycle for Claude Agent SDK and subagent sessions in OpenCode, including event flow and metadata coverage.
constraints: Claude Agent SDK tools are provider-executed; local execution is bypassed.
Tool progress visibility depends on MessageV2.ToolPart updates and stream events.

options.name: Document current tool event flow and visibility
options.approach: Compile a concise map of stream events (ClaudeNativeStreamEvent) -> SessionProcessor updates -> MessageV2.ToolPart states, plus Bus events and Plugin hooks, and verify which pieces reach client serialization (toModelMessages).
options.what_we_learn: Exact lifecycle signals available today and where they are dropped or transformed.

options.name: Probe metadata gaps in Claude SDK tool flow
options.approach: Trace how tool_use/tool_result/tool_use_summary are translated, compare against ToolMetadataRegistry store-only behavior, and list missing enrichment points.
options.what_we_learn: Where metadata is lost (tool_use_id, title, sessionId, attachments) and concrete insertion points.
options.risk_if_wrong: Low-medium; requires careful mapping of SDK message variants.

options.name: Validate subagent session propagation
options.approach: Follow TaskTool -> SessionPrompt.prompt -> Bus subscription flow and produce a parent-child session diagram with data passed back (summary, sessionId, model).
options.what_we_learn: How subagent outputs and tool progress are surfaced to parent sessions, and what is missing for full tool visibility.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it yields the fastest end-to-end visibility map and establishes a shared baseline for any follow-up changes.
